notes.title: All Ashes and Illusions released on Steam
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I'm writing an announcement to let you know that my newest VN, [i]All Ashes and Illusions[/i], has been released on Steam!

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33024327/190eeea69ee5b3911ea251da9cc0f7b4e523e3cc.png[/img]

[i]Ashes[/i] is a fairly grim 'romance' story about a delusional young prince who falls obsessively in love with his childhood nursemaid, Safiya.

[i]Ashes[/i] features content some people might find discomforting, such as: a relationship with a 20 year age difference (Yuel, the protagonist and delusional young prince, is 20, while Safiya, his nursemaid and love interest, is 41), dub/noncon, written depictions of violence, coarse language, and a lot of casual misogyny.

[i]Ashes[/i] is quite a painful read, but it's one of my favourite stories I've written to date, and I'm very fond of the characters. Do consider checking it out, if you're after a VN with an older love interest, and you don't mind a hefty dose of Despair and Suffering! I'd be very interested to hear what people make of this story (and Yuel, in particular), and whether it succeeds in ousting [i]Sweetest Monster[/i] from its position of 'The Most Unpleasant ebi Story to Date'!

If you enjoyed some of my grimmer stories that tackle unsettling subject matter, such as the aforementioned [i]Sweetest Monster[/i], [i]The Mermaid of Zennor[/i], or [i]Six Days of Snow[/i], it might be worth checking out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1673020

- ebi x

notes.title: French Translation
notes.content:
Hi, everyone!

Just writing a post to let you know that Lynne has been updated. The game now features a full French translation!

This translation shouldn't interfere with any old saves made, as I didn't have to make any large changes to the code, so your old saves should work fine.

As always, please let me know if you encounter any problems with the new build, or if you find any typos!
Thank you very much, and I hope you enjoy Lynne!

- ebi x

notes.title: German translation
notes.content:
Hi, everyone!

Just writing a quick post to let you know that Lynne has been updated. The game now features a full German translation, which is very exciting!

I also fixed a handful of typos in the English script, and made some small tweaks to the UI to make the game look a bit prettier.

Please note: I had to make some substantial changes to the script to accommodate these changes, which will break old saves made before this update. If you’ve read through the story once, and you want to read through it again, you’ll have to start a brand new game. I’m sorry for the inconvenience.

Enjoy!

- ebi x

notes.title: The Mermaid of Zennor released on Steam
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Just writing a post to let you know that my newest VN, The Mermaid of Zennor, has been released on Steam!
I'm plugging it here because Mermaid shares many similarities with Lynne. Both stories are set in the UK, featuring angsty teenage girl protagonists, and they deal with obsession as the main theme.
Mermaid's heavily ambient OST was also composed by the same artist who did Lynne's score!

If you liked Lynne, there's a good chance you'll like Mermaid too!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1502520/The_Mermaid_of_Zennor/

I hope you enjoy it, if you do give it a glance over!

- ebi x

notes.title: nothing & nowhere released on Steam
notes.content:
My newest VN, nothing & nowhere, has been released on Steam! It’s a relatively short, kinetic story about overcoming trauma, with a lot of relaxing ambient sound effects.

nothing & nowhere is also related to Lynne, so if you liked Lynne, you might want to check it out. It should help answer a few questions left by Lynne, and tie up some loose ends.

You can purchase nothing & nowhere here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1166730/nothing__nowhere/ 

Thank you for your support, and I hope you enjoy it if you choose to check it out!

- ebi x
